# 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap

Generated by `npm run build` from the feature files in `src/components/` and the step definitions in `src/tests/_shared-steps/`. Edit those, not this file.

Level A. [Understanding 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap on w3.org](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/no-keyboard-trap.html).

Scenarios: automatic.

## Setup

- [`Given I load the sample "<input-url>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/1-Given/samples-load.js) — Loads a sample to test from a web URL.
- [`When I focus "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-focused.js) — Focuses an element programmatically (without a keyboard press). Note: May not activate :focus-visible styles.
- [`When I press the "<key>" key once`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/keyboard-events-occur.js) — Presses a key on the keyboard.
- [`When I hold the "<key>" key`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/keyboard-events-occur.js) — Holds a key on the keyboard.
- [`When I click on "<selector>"`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/mouse-events-occur.js) — Clicks an element with the primary mouse button
- [`When I focus "<selector>" using a keyboard`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-focused.js) — Focuses an element using the keyboard. Note: Will activate :focus-visible styles.

## Assertions

- [`Then the focus should not be on a "<selector>" element`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element is NOT currently focused.
- [`Then "<selector>" should be focused`](../../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element is currently focused.

## Example

```gherkin
Background:
  Given I load the sample "http://localhost:8081/accordion/examples/default"

@2.1.2 @a @automatic
Rule: 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap, Level A
  Scenario: The accordion does not trap focus going forwards
    When I focus ".tl-accordion__section:nth-of-type(3) > button"
    And I press the "TAB" key once
    Then the focus should not be on a ".tl-accordion__section > button" element
```
